question: THE 2.55-KEV LINE PROFILE -- the framework's one derived X-ray observable, fully specified: (1) the width (the full Gaussian sigma in eV from the committed velocity, thermal and core scales), (2) the spatial profile (the surface brightness I(b) of the committed phantom+ dust composite vs the NFW core), (3) the environmental test (present in the frozen class, absent in the never-froze dwarfs), (4) verdicts V1/V2/V3 with the three numbers that confirm or kill the particle face.

thermal_width.source: Z7 cluster-class window mean (2-5 R500), 334 K class
thermal_width.honest_note: Z7 DEFINES T_dark = m sigma_r^2/k_B, so the thermal width IS the species' kinematic width -- one physical velocity scale read two ways, not an independent broadening

core_width.source: Z7/S04 committed core dispersion (E2-primary inner bins 859/829 -> 844)

full_profile.form: dN/dE ~ exp[-(E - E_line)^2/(2 sigma_E^2)], sigma_E = E_line x sigma_v,los/c
full_profile.quadrature_note: conservative upper bound; NOT physical as a single species (thermal and core are one velocity scale)

density_law.phantom: A_ph r^-2 (G098/G233 isothermal equilibrium within r_M)

composite.form: I(b) = pi A_ph/b + 2 A_d K(0.7) b^-0.7
composite.reading: steepens INWARD to the phantom cusp (-> 1.0); dust-dominated outward (-> 0.7); never flat

cdm_comparison.nfw_form: Sigma(R) = 2 rho_s r_s g(R/r_s); g(0) = pi/2 - 1 (FLAT core), g(1) = 1/3, g ~ x^-2 outside
cdm_comparison.signature: b^-1 cusp (diverge) vs NFW flat core: the innermost bins separate the composite from a CDM halo

never_froze_class.reading: the equilibrium never decoupled; the 5.09-keV phase mass is UNDEFINED -> NO 2.55-keV line

part3_environment.prediction: 2.55-keV line PRESENT in the frozen class, ABSENT in the never-froze dwarfs
part3_environment.falsifier: a 2.55-keV line from a UFD/dSph (z* < 0) kills the freeze-map face of the particle sector

verdicts.V1: THE LINE PROFILE: a Gaussian in photon energy at E = m/2 = 2.5443 keV with sigma_E = E x sigma_v,los/c.  At the COMMITTED caustic/dust footing (G182 sigma_d = 140.2 km/s): sigma_E = 1.19 eV (FWHM 2.80 eV) -- the headline width.  The dark sector's own hotter footings widen it: the thermal width at T_dark = 334 K (Z7) is 6.05 eV (v_th = 713 km/s) and the core (beta-profile) width at sigma_r,core = 844 km/s (S04) is 7.16 eV (inner-bin sigma_los = 952 km/s caps the envelope at 8.08 eV).  THE FULL PREDICTED PROFILE: sigma_E in [1.19, 8.08] eV across the committed dark-sector velocity scales; the width is Doppler-dominated, never intrinsic (no rate predicted, A05).  HONEST READING: T_dark = m sigma_r^2/k_B by construction, so the thermal and kinematic widths are ONE velocity scale read two ways -- the committed 1.19 eV (cold dust/caustic) and the phantom's 6-7 eV are the two dark-sector faces of the same emitter.
verdicts.V2: THE SURFACE-BRIGHTNESS SIGNATURE: the line flux follows the dark density rho_ph = A/r^2 + A_d r^-1.7 inside r_M (G098 phantom + G139 dust class); with a constant rate the Abel projection gives I(b) = pi A_ph/b + 2 A_d K(0.7) b^-0.7 -- the phantom b^-1 CUSP (exact, numerically verified) plus the shallower dust b^-0.7 (numerically verified).  The composite local slope -d ln I/d ln b runs in [0.7, 1.0] inside r_M, steepening INWARD to the phantom cusp: at b = 0.1 r_M the composite sits 6.4x above its r_M level (the pure phantom 10x).  THE SEPARATION FROM CDM: an NFW halo projects FLAT-CORED (slope -> 0, 1.4x from 1 to 0.1 r_s) then steepens to -2; the framework's line DIVERGES toward the center where the CDM's is flat -- the innermost bins separate the composite from a CDM halo.
verdicts.V3: THE HONEST STATEMENT -- the three numbers that would confirm or kill the particle face: (1) THE ENERGY: E = m/2 = 2.5443 keV (band [2.50, 2.60]); a line at E != m/2 for the same m kills the m/2 relation (A05 kill band).  (2) THE WIDTH: sigma_E = 1.19 eV (envelope [1.19, 8.08] eV); a resolved width far outside E x sigma_v/c over the committed dark-sector velocity scales kills the kinematic reading.  (3) THE SPATIAL LAW: I(b) ~ b^-1 cusp (local slope -> 1 inward, in [0.7, 1.0] within r_M); a flat-cored (NFW-like) line surface brightness kills the phantom r^-2 face.  AND THE ENVIRONMENTAL SWITCH: the line is present in the frozen class (galaxy/group/cluster, z* >= 0) and absent in the never-froze dwarfs (dSph/UFD, z* < 0, G213) -- a 2.55-keV line from a UFD kills the freeze-map face independently of the rate.  The honest limits: the framework predicts the ENERGY, the WIDTH and the SPATIAL LAW, not the RATE -- non-observation everywhere kills only the radiative implementation, never the mass; the width is Doppler-dominated and the thermal/core footings are one velocity scale; the cusp-vs-core is a projected-density statement from the committed r^-2 phantom.

gates.a_single_value_no_search: a single pre-registered observable (the committed m/2 line); no search was performed
gates.b_FDR: nothing fitted: the width, spatial and environmental statements are closed forms from committed registers; FDR not applicable
gates.c_accuracy: every recomputation reproduces the committed registers to <= 0.1% (1.19 eV from G182's sigma_d; 334 K from Z7; 844 km/s from S04; 2.5443 keV from A05); the Abel projections are verified numerically (slopes -1.00 and -0.70)
gates.d_mechanism: the Doppler width sigma_E = E x sigma_v/c; the Abel projection of the committed densities (rho_ph = A/r^2 exact, rho_dust r^-1.7 verified); the freeze-map phase condition (G213 z*). HONEST CAVEATS: the decay rate is NOT predicted (A05); T_dark and sigma_r are one physical velocity scale (Z7 definition); the cusp-vs-core is a projected-density statement
gates.e_framework_originated: every number from the committed registers (G182, Z7, S04, G139, G213, G098, G212, A05); no literature refit, no fit anywhere
f_falsifiers: energy: a line at E != m/2 (not in [2.50, 2.60] keV for m = 5.09) kills the m/2 relation
width: a resolved Gaussian sigma_E far outside [1.2, 8.1] eV at 2.55 keV kills the kinematic (Doppler) reading
spatial: a flat-cored (NFW-like) 2.55-keV line surface brightness kills the phantom r^-2 cusp face
environment: a 2.55-keV line from a never-froze dwarf (z* < 0) kills the freeze-map face; non-observation everywhere kills only the radiative implementation, never the mass (no rate predicted)
